summary: Keep the agents roster published from one background refresher so roster reads and streams never wait for a fold

replay.detail: No claim replay or stored history changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, version or stored data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Agents lists and windows are answered from the roster a background refresher publishes, fenced at that roster's own snapshot index, which can be older than the reader's; every served roster's snapshot carries the new optional published_at time. A first page waits up to a second for a roster at its own cut. With nothing published yet the read returns a retryable 503 (WebSocket: resync); a page continuation whose roster is no longer published returns page-cursor-expired. Streams reread when a newer roster is published. Older clients ignore the new field.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption or startup migration is required. The daemon folds the roster in the background as it starts.

recovery.detail: Only volatile in-memory caches change; reverting restores per-read exact-cut folds.
